verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is built around delegating coding/debugging/automation tasks to its built-in Gemini AI agent (querying codebases, debugging, automating PR/rebase workflows, non-interactive scripting) per gemini-cli-gh-1/3/4/6/12. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict reliable task delegation: users report it getting stuck in error loops for an hour, failing basic function calling/edit operations, and in one case catastrophically deleting user data during an agentic task. Missing for 10: independent benchmark or docs confirming robust multi-step task completion, resolution of the documented reliability failures, and evidence these loop/data-loss issues have been fixed.
